items.definition:
an oven that heats food using microwave radiation
Heat the leftovers in the microwave.

an outing where a meal is eaten outdoors
We're going for a picnic in the park this afternoon.

minced meat in a casing
I had sausages for breakfast.

a large cupboard for clothes
I need a new wardrobe for my bedroom.

a soft, light covering of a bird
The bird had a beautiful blue feather.

the child of one's son or daughter
My grandmother loves spending time with her grandchild.

a preschool for young children
My daughter started kindergarten this year.

an outdoor area provided for children to play on
The children ran to the playground after school.

a small edible crustacean
I ordered shrimp pasta for dinner.

a bag carried on the back
She packed her books in her backpack.

a platform projecting from the wall of a building
We enjoyed the view from the hotel balcony.

a small wild flower
She picked a daisy from the field.

a box-like storage compartment
I keep my socks in the top drawer.

a large flightless seabird of the southern hemisphere
Penguins are excellent swimmers.

a person who works on a boat or ship
The sailor steered the ship through the storm.

a powerful motor vehicle used for pulling farm machinery
The farmer used a tractor to plow the field.

a card or gift given on Valentine's Day
He sent her a beautiful valentine.

a person who does not eat meat
My sister is a vegetarian and eats only vegetables.

a long, soft-bodied invertebrate animal
The bird pulled a worm out of the ground.

a fossil reptile of the Mesozoic era
Many children are fascinated by dinosaurs.

any plant with leaves, seeds, or flowers used for flavoring, food, medicine, or perfume

a sweet, clear, semisolid fruit product made by boiling fruit juice with sugar

a unit of length, equal to 1,000 meters

a round stone fruit with juicy yellow flesh and downy skin

a marine crustacean with a broad carapace, stalked eyes, and five pairs of legs
We saw a crab scuttling sideways on the beach.

a small cube with each side having a different number of spots

a long narrow band or strip

a thick, sweet liquid

the profession of a teacher

a name used to identify a user

a mountain with a crater

a person who sells meat

the strip of hair growing above each eye

a unit of liquid capacity

a fragrant liquid

a photograph taken of oneself

a flat, shallow container

a folding cover or holder for loose papers

personal ornaments, such as necklaces, rings, or bracelets

an evening meal

a stringed musical instrument

a small hot-tasting pod of a type of capsicum

bracelet

haircut

a sweater (UK); a person who jumps

a strip of pasta or similar dough

a piece of clothing covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg

a soft white porous limestone
